verified_facts.text: The hotel is on Chicago's Gold Coast, a short stroll from Oak Street's boutiques, the Magnificent Mile and Oak Street Beach on Lake Michigan.
verified_facts.excerpt: A short stroll from our boutique hotel, discover Oak Street’s trendy boutiques, the Magnificent Mile and the beauty of Lake Michigan at Oak Street Beach.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is 21 East Bellevue Place, Chicago.
verified_facts.excerpt: 21 East Bellevue Place, Chicago, IL 60611, United States of America

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have 400-thread-count Sferra linens, rainfall showers, mid-century modern furnishings and artwork.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring 400-thread count Sferra linens, rainfall showers, mid-century modern furnishings and inspired artwork

verified_facts.text: The two-story Penthouse Suites feature a billiards table and an outdoor terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: live like a local in one of our two-story Penthouse Suites, featuring a billiards table and a sprawling outdoor terrace

verified_facts.text: Select rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Lake Michigan, tree-lined streets and the Magnificent Mile.
verified_facts.excerpt: Select rooms and suites at our Gold Coast hotel boast floor-to-ceiling windows so you can wake up to glittering views of Lake Michigan, tree-lined downtown streets, the Magnificent Mile and more.

verified_facts.text: The Thompson Suite has in-room fitness amenities including a Peloton bike and free weights.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stick to your wellness routine with in-room fitness amenities, including a Peloton bike and free weights.

verified_facts.text: The Skyline Loft Suite with Terrace is bi-level, with a spiral staircase, a dining table for four and a private balcony terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: This stylish Gold Coast retreat features a focal spiral staircase, dining table for four, separate living room, rainfall shower and a king bed.

verified_facts.text: Tavern on Rush is the hotel's flagship restaurant and bar, serving steak and seafood.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover some of downtown Chicago’s finest steak and seafood at our hotel’s flagship restaurant and bar, Tavern on Rush.

verified_facts.text: Tavern on Rush has multi-level seating, private dining, a bar and an outdoor patio on Rush Street.
verified_facts.excerpt: This unique steakhouse features multi-level seating, private dining, a bustling bar and downtown Chicago's favorite outdoor patio on famous Rush Street.

verified_facts.text: Tavern on Rush serves brunch on Saturdays and Sundays.
The fitness center has Peloton bikes, rowing machines, cardio and strength equipment and is available to guests around the clock.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay in shape on the road with our modern fitness center, complete with Peloton bikes, row machines, cardio and strength training equipment. Available to guests 24/7.

verified_facts.text: The fourth-floor Froines Room lounge has a floor-to-ceiling half-moon window overlooking Bellevue Street.
verified_facts.excerpt: Host a timeless event overlooking Bellevue Street and downtown Chicago from our hotel’s moody, modern fourth-floor lounge known as the Froines Room, featuring a floor-to-ceiling half-moon window

verified_facts.text: Thompson Chicago is dog-friendly; dogs cannot be left unattended in guest rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thompson Chicago is a Dog-friendly hotel. Dogs cannot be left unattended in guest rooms and all fees are subject to change.

verified_facts.text: A daily destination fee applies to each room, covering perks such as a discount at the 360 Chicago Observation Deck and daily bottled water.
verified_facts.excerpt: a daily destination fee of $25.00 (subject to change) will apply to each room of your stay at Thompson Chicago

verified_facts.text: The nearest CTA station is Chicago/State on the Red Line.
verified_facts.excerpt: The nearest CTA station to Thompson Chicago is the Chicago/State station. This station is served by the Red Line

verified_facts.text: Valet parking is available at the hotel entrance around the clock.
verified_facts.excerpt: During your stay in downtown Chicago, valet parking is available at the hotel entrance 24/7
